scope_note: Evidence-supported guidance is separated from conservative inference and explicit product requirements.

principles.principle: Represent section hierarchy and reading sequence explicitly before document rendering.
principles.observable_check: Ordered semantic structure; renderer later verifies PDF/DOCX reading order.

principles.principle: Use descriptive real headings rather than relying only on font size, color or visual placement.
principles.observable_check: Structured section labels map to semantic document headings.

principles.principle: Accessibility and ATS checks overlap but neither guarantees the other.
principles.observable_check: Report separate text-extraction, reading-order and parser-specific results.

principles.principle: Structured content validation cannot certify the accessibility of a future binary document.
principles.observable_check: PDF/DOCX tagging, reading order and assistive-technology checks remain File Generator responsibilities.
